header_status_at_freeze: bounded physical header probe running; no row-level outcome content opened

endpoint.fit_policy: fit exactly once on pooled calibration colonisation-risk rows; never refit on heldout target outcomes
endpoint.sequential_layer_a_policy: for each transition, construct features from state and surviving worlds known before the target year; score heldout target; only after scoring may that target outcome contract Layer A for the next year

state_semantics.registry: 53 frozen Stegall glade nodes from the response-independent documented glade/section aggregation
state_semantics.survey_zero_basis: published Stegall protocol surveyed each glade at least three times per field season throughout 1995-2006, while E092-148-S1 documents population-size rows only for years of occupation
state_semantics.occupied: a valid S1 Stegall glade-year row in 1995-2006 with finite estimated population size > 0
state_semantics.surveyed_zero: a frozen registry glade-year in 1995-2006 with no S1 occupation row, conditional on the complete annual all-glade Stegall survey protocol
state_semantics.colonisation_risk_set: glade surveyed zero at source year t
state_semantics.event: risk-set glade is occupied at target year t+1
state_semantics.non_event: risk-set glade remains surveyed zero at target year t+1
state_semantics.current_sources: all occupied frozen registry glades at source year t
state_semantics.out_of_window_rows: parse and audit identity, then exclude prospectively by year; they never enter features, updates, counts or scores
state_semantics.non_Stegall_rows: parse and audit identity, then exclude prospectively by mountain/glade prefix; they never enter features, updates, counts or scores

glade_token_semantics.case_policy: ASCII case-insensitive by uppercasing before the exact regex
glade_token_semantics.canonical_id: SM plus the captured base-10 integer with no leading-zero padding
glade_token_semantics.section_suffix_in_S1: not accepted because S1 is documented at glade, not section, level
glade_token_semantics.numeric_only_alias: not accepted unless independently documented before row-level access

count_gate.failure: terminal non-estimable stop with zero Layer-A outcome updates, zero model fits and zero heldout scores

layer_a.distance: great-circle distance between frozen response-independent representative glade coordinates
layer_a.kernel_scale_basis: response-blind 50-percent LCC structural threshold; analytical scale only, not a fitted movement distance
layer_a.hard_world_pair_weight: exp(-distance/kernel_scale) for distinct glade pairs at or below that world's frozen threshold, else zero
layer_a.target_support: arithmetic mean of Q[s,j] across all current occupied source glades
layer_a.update: after each observed transition, eliminate a surviving world if any newly colonised risk-set target has support <= 1e-15
layer_a.all_worlds_eliminated: terminal frozen-universe falsification; no threshold/source rescue and no paired predictive classification for missing later outer units

exposure_formulas.unweighted_exponential_source_connectivi: sum_s exp(-d(s,j)/scale) over current occupied sources
exposure_formulas.population_weighted_exponential_source_c: sum_s population_s * exp(-d(s,j)/scale) over current occupied sources

conventional_baseline_features.missing_or_nonfinite_feature: terminal pre-fit stop; no imputation discovered from outcome
conventional_baseline_features.feature_scaling: none; random forest uses raw finite numeric columns

paired_comparator.baseline: frozen strong random forest on conventional_baseline_features
paired_comparator.augmented: identical random forest on identical rows and conventional features plus unchanged ten-column Layer B

fire_boundary.interpretation: Layer B tests added value of frozen source-reachability world-set structure after a strong learner already receives the major known management-stage signal
